## **Detailed Mathematical & Symmetry Notes** 

## **1. Normal Zeeman Effect (NZE)** 

- **System:** Singlet states ( _S_ = 0 = _⇒ J_ = _L, gJ_ = 1). 

- **Matrix Element & Integrand:** The interaction operator is _H_<sup>ˆ</sup><sup>_′_</sup> = _µBBz_ _<u>L</u>_ ˆ _h_ ¯ _<u>z</u>_<sup>.Acting</sup> on the orbital state _|nlml⟩_ : 

   - _L_ ˆ _z|nlml⟩_ = _mlh_ ¯ _|nlml⟩_ = _⇒⟨n_<sup>_′_</sup> _l_<sup>_′_</sup> _m_<sup>_′_</sup> _l_<sup>_|_ˆ</sup><sup>_H′|nlml⟩_=</sup><sup>_µBBzmlδnn′δll′δm_</sup> _l_<sup>_m′_</sup> _l_ 

- **Radiative Selection Rules (E1 Transition):** For an electric dipole transition driven by operator _⃗r_ = ( _r_ sin _θ_ cos _ϕ, r_ sin _θ_ sin _ϕ, r_ cos _θ_ ):

- ∗ _q_ = _±_ 1 = _⇒_ ∆ _ml_ = _±_ 1 ( _σ_ -components, light circularly polarized perpendicular to _⃗B_ ). 

## **2. Anomalous Zeeman Effect (AZE)** 

- **System:** States with non-zero spin ( _S̸_ = 0). Weak magnetic field (∆ _EZ ≪_ ∆ _ESO_ ). 

- **Projection Theorem & Integrand:** In the coupled basis _|nlsjmj⟩_ , the magnetic operator is _H_<sup>ˆ</sup><sup>_′_</sup> =<sup>_<u>µB</u>_</sup> _h_ ¯<sup>_Bz_</sup> ( _L_<sup>ˆ</sup> _z_ + 2 _S_<sup>ˆ</sup> _z_ ). Using the Wigner-Eckart Projection Theorem:

## **3. Paschen-Back Effect** 

- **System:** Strong magnetic field (∆ _EZ ≫_ ∆ _ESO_ ). 

- **Decoupling Mechanism & Integrand:** The external magnetic field breaks _L_ - _S_ coupling. _L_ and _S_ precess independently around _⃗B_ = _Bzz_ ˆ. The appropriate basis is the uncoupled basis _|l, s, ml, ms⟩_ . 

**– Main Magnetic Term:** 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
⟨l, s, ml, ms| µBBz ( L ˆ z  + 2  S ˆ z ) |l, s, ml, ms⟩ =  µBBz ( ml  + 2 ms )<br>h ¯<br><!-- End of picture text -->

**– First-Order Spin-Orbit Correction Integrand:** _H_ ˆ _SO_ = _Anl⃗L ·⃗S_ = _Anl_ � _L_ ˆ _z_ ˆ _Sz_ + 2<sup><u>1</u>(ˆ</sup><sup>_L_+ ˆ</sup><sup>_S−_+</sup><sup>_L_ˆ</sup><sup>_−S_ˆ+)</sup> �. Since ladder operators _L_ ˆ _±_ ˆ _S∓_ shift _ml → ml ±_ 1 and _ms → ms ∓_ 1, their diagonal expectation values in the uncoupled basis vanish identically:
